CP26/12: Proposed changes to the client assets sourcebook

Published: 14/08/2026

We are consulting on proposed changes to the client assets sourcebook (CASS) that would extend safeguarding requirements to firms holding qualifying crypto-assets on behalf of clients.

Who this applies to

This consultation is relevant to:

  1. Crypto-asset service providers registered under the MLRs
  2. Firms seeking full authorisation under the future crypto regime

Summary of proposals

ChapterChange
CASS 14New safeguarding rules for qualifying crypto-assets
CASS 6Consequential amendments to custody rules

Responses are due by 14 November 2026. Read the full consultation paper (PDF).
